newFindings.observed: Nuevo prospecto renders Canal, Producto and Ramo as free-text inputs with hardcoded/default text while the existing management editor already uses catalog-backed selects.
newFindings.rootCause: core/ciclo.js nuevoNegocio() uses fInput for nn-canal/nn-prod/nn-ramo; edit flow uses fSelectCat. Current Orbit.cat persists only in browser localStorage and Configuración has no durable shared catalog administration surface.
newFindings.requiredFix: Use one tenant-durable catalog owner for new/edit flows; Dirección/Admin administer catalogs in Configuración; country-aware ramo/product where applicable; no hardcoded defaults as business truth.

newFindings.observed: Paula completed missing email, but the row/missing reason did not reliably clear and the change appeared not to persist as expected.
newFindings.rootCause: calidad.js completion modal uses synchronous store.update plus immediate local readback instead of updateDurable/server-confirmed readback.
newFindings.requiredFix: Use durable awaited update with server readback, audit/motivo, rerender only from confirmed state, and prove reload persistence.

newFindings.observed: Ciudad/municipio selector does not expose the complete locality list; capture shows only placeholder/Otro when department data is unavailable in the reduced catalog.
newFindings.rootCause: Orbit.GEO is a reduced embedded subset, not a complete authoritative GT/CO geographic catalog.
newFindings.requiredFix: Bind country→department/province→city/municipality to a complete governed catalog or authoritative tenant reference; preserve Otro/requires-validation fail-closed path.

newFindings.observed: Rows can say Sin evidencia vinculada although client ficha/edit already contains country; user cannot distinguish current value from provenance evidence.
newFindings.rootCause: Quality table labels external linked-evidence absence as if country itself were absent/unsubstantiated, while current client country and evidence lineage are separate concepts.
newFindings.requiredFix: Show current country and provenance separately; user-confirmed durable update becomes auditable evidence; never imply country is missing when value exists.

newFindings.observed: Sin canal is rendered as a disabled button and does nothing.
newFindings.rootCause: calidad.js intentionally renders disabled Sin canal when no usable phone/email exists.
newFindings.requiredFix: Render as non-action badge or actionable Agregar canal that opens completion focused on contact fields; no dead button.

newFindings.surface: Calidad de datos/Salud póliza vs calendario
newFindings.observed: Mismatch rows expose contractual premium/calendar/delta but no action, no drill-down, and clicking policy does not open context or explain what must be validated.
newFindings.rootCause: financialHealthHtml renders informational rows only and does not bind policy/receipt lineage/action surface.
newFindings.requiredFix: Provide policy/receipt drill-down with contractual source, active calendar rows, delta/tolerance, exact validation reason and safe actions; no inferred rewrite. Rows within tolerance must not be false-positive review items.

newFindings.observed: Fail-closed pipeline works but still shows 39 policies pending renewability review/conciliation (GT≈33, CO=6) and some actionable cards lack premium, so the module is not operationally complete.
newFindings.rootCause: Most policies still lack authoritative renovable YES/NO and some renewal financial fields remain source-incomplete; current product correctly refuses to infer them.
newFindings.requiredFix: Resolve renewability/financial completeness from source-backed policy/insurer evidence and visible validation workflow; do not auto-promote UNKNOWN.

newFindings.observed: Tarifas y conocimiento shows related validated sources while Documentos y Drive can show Sin documentos cargados; current classifier is too coarse for tariff/commercial/subscription/claims/etc. document families.
newFindings.rootCause: Reusable Library/knowledge references and insurer Drive-upload registry have distinct semantics that UI does not explain; docs-aseguradora metadata taxonomy is not rich enough.
newFindings.requiredFix: One source registry with storage location/provenance and multi-tag business classification; clearly distinguish referenced Library source from insurer Drive copy; no duplicate source authority.

newFindings.observed: Endoso workflow exists, but current B4 proof has not demonstrated exhaustive endoso E2E and no equivalent proven first-class creation workflow was found for certificates/annexes.
newFindings.rootCause: Historical v1.201 implemented endoso application flows and versioned tests, but its own audit left full-repo execution/smoke and several endoso types/backend durability pending; certificate remains an Ops management type rather than a proven document-generation lifecycle.
newFindings.requiredFix: Reconcile latest approved scope for Endosos/Certificados/Anexos, reuse existing v1.201 owners, and include exact E2E coverage in B4-005; do not rebuild parallel workflows.
